fields.value: The eldest Bennet sister and widely admired for her beauty and gentle expression.
Warm, modest, generous, composed, and reluctant to suspect ill motives.
To love without bitterness and to think well of others while protecting private feeling.
Eldest of the five Bennet daughters and Elizabeth’s closest confidante.
Not stated precisely; the eldest Bennet daughter and a young adult.
Half of the principal parallel romance and a moral counterpoint to Elizabeth’s sharper judgment.
Daughter of Mr and Mrs Bennet; especially close to Elizabeth.
Longbourn; later an estate near Pemberley with Bingley.
Endures separation without surrendering generosity, then accepts Bingley when he returns with independent purpose.
Bingley: mutual affection. Elizabeth: intimate sister. Caroline: misplaced trust followed by clearer understanding.
